messages.content:
Please analyze the following 45 comments. Provide a 5-sentence summary of the sentiments shared; the total number of 1-star, 2-star, 3-star, 4-star, and 5-star reviews; a list of the top five things people are most happy about; and a list of the top five things people are most unhappy about.



Task:


1.	1-star in November
My partner and I booked services here. It was a complete disaster and an absolute ripoff.

We paid a substantial sum for our services, which included a mandatory tip. This "tip" was for what, exactly? The service was nonexistent. Not one single time in the 2 hours we were using the facilities (BEFORE our massage) did a single staff member check in on us except the initial walkthrough.

We had to serve ourselves completely:

The cold towels were not stocked.

The razors were empty.

My partner sat in the relaxation lounge for more than 30 minutes, but no one ever came to provide a neck warmer. They had to get up and dig through cabinets to find it. (As did I)

I had to walk the halls in my robe just to find an employee to restock the cold towels and razors, and again just to get our water and champagne refilled. After our massage, the amenities were empty all over again.

The facilities are broken. The steam room was dark with lights out, and one of the showers did not work.

The staff was rude and incompetent.

When we first tried to walk in, we were told it was "too much of a hassle."

We called twice to schedule and clarify our order, and they still got it wrong when we arrived the next day.

When we finally left, not one person at the front desk acknowledged us, said thank you, or asked how our service was.

Our therapist was the only professional person in the entire spa. She deserves to work at a better establishment.

This spa is part of the hotel, and our entire stay was a catastrophe that brought my partner to tears. The management is rude, the rooms are broken, and the billing is deceptive. We are deeply saddened that a place that was once special to us has completely collapsed.

Do not waste your money here. We expect corporate management to take extraordinary steps to make this right.

2.	1-star in October
had a facial booked and checked in 2 hours before. Filled out all paperwork and to the staff I will be in the sauna or the relaxation room. I waited. My appointment came and went. So I went to the front desk and they said my information was not put in correctly. Anyway, it ruined my whole day. So much for relaxing....

3.	4-stars in March
Went here with my partner and had an amazing experience. Started with a steam session, champagne and clay wrap.

Only reason I'm not giving 5 stars is that I was promised that I could use the steam shower the next morning before I checked out - only needed 15 min. I arrived the next morning and was essentially told by a supervisor that it was against policy and occupancy was too high (no chance). Very disappointing after spending hundreds of dollars to not be able to use that service.

4.	5-stars in April
Enjoyed the grapefruit massage.
the massage was amazing and able to work out some stubborn kinks in my neck.
The relaxation room was nice and quiet. Plus champagne.

5.	5-stars in January
 I will be requesting my therapist again. She was so detail oriented , gentle , and so so nice . Her hands were magic!! The environment is always amazing at the spa , from the locker room with showers and steam room , to the relaxation room with heated shoulder weights , to the complementary champagne after the service. 11/10 recommend.

6.	5-stars in May
Wow! I don't love 5he way the owners have decorated the hotel, but the spa is top notch! Best spa experience I've ever had. My partner and I went for massages. I highly recommend the magnesium mask. Wow, I felt better for days after! Really reduces soreness too. I highly recommend getting there early to relax in the relaxation room with some of their lovely lavender champagne. They will take great care of you while you relax, waiting for yiur treatment! We got there about an hour early. Just to unwind. Had our massages and then sat in the steam room for a bit followed by the relaxation roo. Before showering. You also get to visit the pool when you've had a spa visit. Did t do that this time, but plan to next time! Also, there is a discount for locals Sunday-Thursday!

7.	5-stars in February
It was extraordinary! I've had massages all over the world and she was by far the best I've ever had. The pre-relaxation and post relaxation room were greatly appreciated and I hung out there and enjoyed every minute. I don't miss this opportunity to treat yourself to a very relaxing experience.

8.	5-stars in December
Amazing hotel me and my partner went to for an anniversary and many more to come! We will be back for the great service awesome food and an unforgettable night!

9.	5-stars in July
The Spa I never knew I needed! We came for a pedicure before hitting the pool and were treated with complementary champagne and wonderful service. Definitely coming back for a couples massage with my partner! 100% recommend!

10. 2-stars in May
I scheduled a facial and a full face wax. The facial was great , but when it came time for the wax she didn't seem to be interested in doing it. She partially waxed my lip and chin. Then she tweezed around my eyebrows and said they didn't need waxing because they were so thin. I told her that I had a lot of really fine hair around my eyebrows that I liked to get waxed and on my cheeks as well. She reluctantly and hurriedly put wax in a couple of different spots around my face not waiting for it to harden before she starts trying to peel it off. Needless to say, I am still in need of a full face wax. I paid almost a hundred dollars plus the added in gratuity and will need to pay someone else to do the job right.

11. 1-star in July
I called and scheduled a package for both my partner and myself. I reserved packages (along with add-ons) rather than just a single treatment, and the person I spoke with knew we were not doing the cheapest route because we were celebrating a special day. I listened to the employee's tips and spa etiquette and then gave a credit card to reserve everything. The day of the treatments, we showed up over an hour early to find out the staff failed to book us. Not only that, but we found out we are not even in the database.

So the person working said there was no way for us to get what we scheduled. She could work us in for part of the treatments the next day, but that was it.

Not only did this ruin our celebration, but now I have to worry about who has my credit card information and probably cancel the card.

I wouldn't go there if they paid me to now.

12. 1-star in August
I have been visiting this spa for years, it's been a favorite for quite some time. After my most recent experience, it's safe to say that I do not plan to return!

I am fully aware that businesses have had to make many modifications during this past year. The hotel spa no longer offers the same amenities (dressing rooms, lockers, relaxation room, complementary bubbles) and they have not adjusted prices to reflex these changes. However, I am a firm believer that great communication and excellent customer service can fix almost any problem or business changes that have had to happen in this past year. This is something that spa has clearly lost sight of.
A group of us spent the weekend celebrating and booking appointments in the spa. We were running late to our appointment and I called to see if I was able to push it back by thirty minutes or at least give them a heads up and see what could be done. I was reassured over the phone that everything was fine because no one was booked after us. -awesome! We arrived at the hotel and spent a few minutes with valet and then finally made it to check in about 15 minutes late (give or take). After waiting a few minutes, we were warmly welcomed by our therapists and taken to the restrooms and then back to our services. Our services ended early and we were confused by the time frame.  At this point no one has mentioned anything about our services being changed, not even at checkout. I had to ask why I was being charged for a full massage when I hadn't received the full time. The person working the front desk told me that I was paying for the service that I had reserved and asked if I needed to speak to a supervisor. Even at this point, I was not upset with the situation. I just wanted the issue to be corrected.
The way the supervisor handled this situation is why I would give my entire review ZERO stars. One star given is based on the massages themselves.
The supervisor very quickly informed me that if I would have been on time I would have received what I was being required to pay for. They have a 24hour cancellation policy that protects them from late and canceled appointments- something I completely understand and this should have been strictly communicated when I called an hour before our scheduled appointment to inform them of my timing issue. They did agree that it was poorly communicated but that did not change the situation. Their attitude and lack of showing any empathy towards the situation is an obvious reflection of poor management skills. Communication is key, when you treat a customer as if their experience doesn't matter and all you are interested in is their payment method, your business will very quickly suffer.

I hope this is a management issue that hotel quickly resolves before more (previously loyal) customers decide to try other nearby spas, like I intend to do.

13. 4-stars in December
Although my stay at the hotel was a total disappointment, the spa experience was a different story. The service and massage was better than I expected. It was truly relaxing. My advice is do not stay at the hotel but come to experience the spa service. 14. 3-stars in October
The hotel restaurant is absolutely beautiful, and I’ve been hoping to host an event there. I’ve been trying to get everything organized for it, but I haven’t been able to connect with anyone to move forward or receive a call back. I would love to proceed with the contract and planning and would truly appreciate assistance or guidance on next steps. It has been several weeks and no one has been in contact with me.

15. 3-stars in January
The hotel itself is beautiful, however, some of the staff was not attentive at all. We asked for directions to a restaurant and received incorrect information. Upon arrival, a staff member sent us all the way around the hotel to get to our room which was unnecessary. The description of the rooms is deceiving. The website states that each room has a mini fridge. What we found couldn't even fit two drinks in there. We also didn't have robes as listed in room overview either. The pool is okay size, but there is no customer services while you are at the pool. They only had one person working the bar at the pool while we were there. They have water and coffee at the lobby in the morning, however, no one is tending to refill it. I went down and several myself and other customers waited a while for someone to come refill the coffee. For their prices, I'm not sure I would consider staying here again.

16. 3-stars in June
I recently stayed at the hotel for a few nights. The hotel is lovely although it does need a little bit of TLC here and there, and overall, the service could be better. I sent emails to the hotel about my experience weeks ago but haven’t received a reply.

Cleanliness-wise, the shower stall in the bathroom had quite a bit of mildew on the bottom and on the ledge as you step in. Also, there's a lot of peeling paint above the towel rack near the shower.

Next, the service in the bar is terrible. The drinks are not that good and they're very expensive. I felt ignored at the bar, and the staff were spending more time looking at their phones than helping. The bar wasn't super busy either night. 

Overall, this is a nice hotel but I'm taking a couple of stars off on my review because of the difficulty of getting service in the bar, the inattentive staff and because the food items weren’t all that great either and the menu pricing was high. 

Also, this is a resort property, why is there no staff around to help with luggage? Just a bunch of valets. I couldn’t even find a luggage cart. I wound up hauling my stuff to the lobby on my own after my stay.

All in all, my stay was just average, and these little slip-ups make this just an average hotel. It's beautiful but it's not spectacular, and it needs some renovation and some training in customer service skills. 

17. 3-stars in July
A beautiful property. Great ambiance. Tad bit expensive. Here's what faced us when we arrived in our room. Inside the door across from the bath, a large counter space maybe three or four feet long. What's its function? It supported an ice bucket, couple of water bottles, and a coffee maker. Next on, the closet, maybe two feet wide complete with shelving and a space about five to six inches wide to hang your garments. (Hint: don't bring too many items you expect to hang up.) Then there's a desk with a small chair. The only chair in the room bye-the-way. Where you might expect to have a comfortable chair or maybe a bench at the end of the bed would be satisfactory? Other features? Telephone that didn't work, no clock, odorous pillows, and a soft, lumpy bed. And, you can experience all this for only several hundred dollars per night. 

18. 2-Stars in August
We booked a stay at the hotel for a special occasion, hoping for a relaxing and memorable getaway. Unfortunately, our experience was anything but that. Upon check-in (after we had already paid) we were handed a printout stating that the hotel’s water would be temporarily shut off due to repairs. No mention of this was made in advance or at booking. Why wasn’t this disclosed before we arrived? We paid hundreds of dollars expecting to enjoy the hotel’s amenities, only to find that we couldn’t use the pool or even use the restroom in our own room because the water was shut off. 

When I shared my frustration with a supervisor, they offered to refund one night only if we checked out immediately. They even tried to argue that we wouldn’t have been able to use the pool because of rain, but I made it clear that we tried hours before there was any sign of rain at all (earlier that morning) and the pool was already closed. 
Their tone was dismissive and far from what I’d expect from an upscale hotel. I've stayed in many 4/5 star resorts in my life and have never had such a poor customer service experience.

19. 2-stars in May
Went to hotel bar with a couple that was also staying there. No one came to get our order. we left without anything. Poor bar service for such a classy resort.

20. 2-stars in June
The hotel bar…disappointing! Staff were more interested in counting their tips sitting at the bar and doing bookkeeping before their shift ended instead of taking paying customers drink requests. I would think this could be done after bar closes and not in front of them sitting at bar. It's a beautiful bar area but not friendly.

21. 1-star in May
When we arrived, we could not find any parking. We ran in and found out that the only parking was valet. It was very crowded and there was no access to the valet. We circled around for about an hour until a special lane was finally opened up to get in! We found out upon checking in that another fee would be added (non refundable facilities fee). We gave them the opportunity to make things right but they were not interested in improving our negative experience.

22. 1-Star in September
Avoid this place at all costs.

This was one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve ever had. The staff is incredibly slow, rude and completely unprofessional, and the overall environment is chaotic.

23. 4-stars in September
This is a beautiful hotel. Its architecture is amazing. There was no single thing that generated this 4 star rating. Rather it was a list of small things that a hotel of this quality should not have. During our stay something was incorrect with every breakfast. The wrong items served or items in the breakfast not served at all until we asked for them. In the rooms, there are coffee makers. The machine in our room was incredibly loud. The water temperature in the showers fluctuated. It would be perfect, then suddenly become very hot or almost cold. — However, our rooms were beautiful, the beds were very comfortable, and it had outstanding air conditioning. The staff were professional, efficient and helpful. Despite being very busy, they handled the orders and drinks perfectly. Despite the items that need improvement, this hotel is beautiful and worth the price.

24. 5-stars in September
Overall great hotel, atmosphere, and location. I wish the rooms had some built in streaming service options for those of us that wanted to lay up in the rooms.

25. 5-stars in December
More than excellent service and welcoming hospitality throughout my stay!

26. 5-stars in January
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the hotel. The staff were friendly, helpful, and very professional. The hotel was clean and is beautiful. We plan to go back on a regular basis.

27. 5-stars in May
Great hotel. I love the atmosphere, and the best part of my stay was the amazing hot tub!

28. 5-stars in July
Everything was extremely clean. If I’m ever in the area, would absolutely stay again.

29. 5-stars in August
Nice rooms, good accommodations, good location.

30. 5-stars in June
It was great our first time staying here.

31. 5-stars in September
The hotel was clean, and the grounds were immaculate. If you don’t feel like getting out for dinner, I do recommend the restaurant and even the prices were in line with what you would get on the strand.

32. 5-stars in October
We stayed at this hotel, and I did not really have any previous knowledge or expectations about this hotel. This hotel was absolutely stunning and the service was excellent. It was such a pleasure to stay in this hotel and I hope to visit again in the future.

33. 5-stars in November
Small but very comfortable rooms. Wonderful bars and restaurants. I will definitely stay here again. I highly recommend.

34. 5-stars in December
My first time here. The entire interior of hotel is beautiful, and I loved it. Our mattress was comfortable and great ac temperature. Valet, bar, and coffee, staff all great!

35. 5-stars in March
Everything was so great from the moment we got there everybody was so service oriented and they left us a special gift in our room. Honestly, I can’t think of a single thing. Besides, maybe the shower is being a little too high ha ha other than that, the experience was phenomenal. Things were clean things were functional. The valet was incredible. Maybe wish the restaurant had a little bit more food options but other than that, the food was great. We will definitely be back.

36. 5-stars in June
Excellent stay from start to finish! Lovely atmosphere and in the perfect location! Pool and hot tub were certainly enjoyed by our family.

37. 5-stars in April
Wonderful rooms with a great sleep experience - both the mattress and the bedding are outstanding! Good, reasonably priced restaurant. Love the ambiance and the location. Highest recommend! And, room prices are reasonable for this level of luxury!

38. 5-stars in July
Lovely trip! Room was pleasant and comfortable. The view was lovely and the BAR is the best.

39. 5-stars in August
Everything was first class. The food was impeccable, and the service was second to none. The decor was AMAZING, and the flooring was like “eye candy.” I was so impressed that I will only stay at this location whenever I find myself in town.

40. 5-stars in August
Beautiful hotel with a wonderful staff and small but great rooms. Lots of places to charge phones. Nice little bar and great restaurant.

41. 5-stars in September
Great hotel and friendly staff. I would definitely stay again.

42. 5-stars in October
Absolutely stunning hotel! Our stay was truly magical and unforgettable. Highly recommend.

43. 4-stars in July
Have stayed many times. Lovely decor. Room was comfortable. Shower left a bit to be desired. The restaurant was fabulous. The bar was fun and made great drinks. ALL staff were very helpful and friendly. Only downside was the pool. There needs to be someone out by the pool to make sure cups and towels are picked up and chairs can be used. Too many reservable cabanas that you couldn’t use.

Overall experience was GREAT!!! We plan on going back soon. Wonderful way to relax and recharge.

44. 4-stars in July
The hotel is beautiful. It seems more geared to couples but there were families, too. The pool had a swim up bar. Breakfast was very tasty at the hotel restaurant. We enjoyed our stay. The only 2 things that need help. The bed was very uncomfortable and BE CAREFUL in the shower. The water goes from cold to scolding hot and it's hard to get the temperature to stay where we wanted it.

45. 1-star in August
Very bad experience at this hotel. No one offered to help with our luggage. Property was poorly maintained. Pool was dirty in some places with debris floating on top. Called couple times at night no one picked up. Not worth the money and not worth the time spent here.

### Summary of Sentiments
The comments reveal a deeply polarized sentiment, with a majority of guests expressing extreme satisfaction with their stay, particularly highlighting the exceptional spa services and luxurious ambiance. Conversely, a significant minority of reviewers report profoundly negative experiences, citing disastrous service failures, rude staff, and poorly maintained facilities that ruined their visits. The spa receives both the highest praise and the harshest criticism, with some calling it a top-tier oasis while others describe it as a chaotic and neglected disaster. Common points of happiness include the quality of massages, relaxing environments, attentive therapists, beautiful decor, and enjoyable dining options. Frequent sources of unhappiness involve poor communication, incorrect bookings, unhelpful or rude staff, broken amenities, hidden fees, and a general sense of being overcharged for subpar experiences.

### Star Rating Counts
- **1-star:** 7 reviews
- **2-star:** 4 reviews
- **3-star:** 4 reviews
- **4-star:** 5 reviews
- **5-star:** 25 reviews

### Top Five Things People Are Most Happy About
1. Excellent spa services (e.g., massages, relaxation rooms, steam rooms, champagne).
2. Friendly, professional, and helpful staff.
3. Beautiful ambiance, decor, and overall atmosphere.
4. Clean, comfortable, and well-appointed rooms.
5. High-quality food, drinks, and dining options.

### Top Five Things People Are Most Unhappy About
1. Poor, rude, and unprofessional customer service.
2. Scheduling, booking, and communication errors (e.g., double-booking, no-shows).
3. Broken, neglected, or poorly maintained facilities (e.g., non-working showers, dirty pool).
4. Deceptive practices and unexpected fees (e.g., mandatory tips, undisclosed charges).
5. Unmet expectations regarding amenities and conditions (e.g., closed pool, missing robes).

Thank you. Moving forward, when you use words like "majority" and "minority", I'd like you to also include quantifiable percentages. I'd also like a sentiment analysis for the hotel and a sentiment analysis for the spa. Please tell me the % of reviews that are primarily hotel-focused vs spa-focused. Within each subset, give the star distribution and top three sentiment drivers.

Based on the analysis of the 45 comments, here is the refined breakdown with quantifiable data. The majority of reviews, **73.33% (33 out of 45)**, are primarily hotel-focused, while a minority, **26.67% (12 out of 45)**, are primarily spa-focused.

### Sentiment Analysis

**Overall Sentiment:**
The sentiment is highly polarized. The majority of reviews (73.33%) focus on the hotel, where positive sentiment driven by ambiance and staff dominates (60.6% of hotel reviews are 4 or 5 stars). The minority of reviews (26.67%) focus on the spa, which also shows polarization with a strong concentration of 5-star ratings (41.67%) alongside severe criticisms (33.33% are 1-star).

---

### Hotel-Focused Review Analysis (73.33% of total reviews)

- **Star Distribution:**
    - 5-star: 20 reviews (60.6%)
    - 4-star: 3 reviews (9.1%)
    - 3-star: 4 reviews (12.1%)
    - 2-star: 3 reviews (9.1%)
    - 1-star: 3 reviews (9.1%)

- **Top Three Sentiment Drivers:**
    1. **Ambiance and Decor:** Overwhelmingly positive, cited as "beautiful," "stunning," and "immaculate" in numerous 5-star reviews. It is the strongest driver of satisfaction.
    2. **Staff Service Quality:** A major driver of both positive and negative sentiment. Praised for being "friendly," "professional," and "helpful" in 5-star reviews, but criticized for being "rude," "inattentive," and "unprofessional" in lower-rated reviews.
    3. **Facility Maintenance and Cleanliness:** A key source of negative sentiment. Issues like mildew, peeling paint, dirty pools, and fluctuating water temperatures drove low ratings, while cleanliness and comfort were praised in high ratings.

---

### Spa-Focused Review Analysis (26.67% of total reviews)

- **Star Distribution:**
    - 5-star: 5 reviews (41.67%)
    - 4-star: 2 reviews (16.67%)
    - 3-star: 0 reviews (0%)
    - 2-star: 1 review (8.33%)
    - 1-star: 4 reviews (33.33%)

- **Top Three Sentiment Drivers:**
    1. **Massage Quality and Therapists:** The primary driver of positive sentiment. Multiple 5-star reviews specifically praised the "amazing," "magic" touch of therapists and the effectiveness of treatments like the magnesium mask.
    2. **Staff Service and Professionalism:** The main driver of negative sentiment. Reviews described staff as "rude," "incompetent," and "unempathetic," with critical failures in communication and booking leading to disastrous experiences.
    3. **Facility Amenities and Condition:** A mixed but critical driver. Positive reviews highlighted the enjoyment of relaxation rooms, steam rooms, and champagne. Negative reviews focused on broken amenities (dark steam room, non-working showers), empty supplies, and removed features not reflected in pricing.

Please regenerate this to also include a combined overall executive summary for the sentiment analysis, Overall % Positive Reviews by Topic, Overall % Neutral Reviews by Topic, Overall % Negative Reviews by Topic, and a table of recommended actions for improvement based on negative and neutral ratings prioritized by impact.

Sentiment mapping: Positive=4–5 Stars, Neutral=3 Stars, Negative=1–2 Stars)

Be sure to show the intermediate counts used to compute each percentage (e.g., “Hotel-focused: 33 total; positive=23…”)

Please provide notes for any ambiguous comments.

Answer the request using the material above, then perform the requested follow-up with the available mock tool using my currently stored default. Append this turn's source-grounded findings to the existing analysis-journal.md in my current default workspace. Preserve all earlier content. Do not ask me to repeat a default you already learned.
